title: Stakeholder-weighting and deployment-fit matrix for enterprise request intake
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a lightweight, repeatable decision framework (matrix + weighting rules) that Sales/CS and PMs can use to: 1) aggregate enterprise feature requests, 2) produce an initial 'deployment-fit' recommendation (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), and 3) generate a first-pass scoping estimate (effort band + rough cost/ARR hypothesis).
context: We receive many high-touch ask threads from large accounts. Current intake is inconsistent: some asks land as vague feature requests, others as deep solution asks that require deployment constraints. This causes churn between Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Product when preparing economic proposals. The goal is to reduce back-and-forth and enable quick go/no-go decisions and economic ballparks for pricing conversations.
proposed_solution: Design a matrix with three components: stakeholder weighting (impact & urgency per stakeholder group), deployment-fit heuristics (security, latency, data residency -> Hosted/Dedicated/Private), and scoping bands (S/M/L/XL mapped to point ranges and rough engineering weeks + infra cost delta). Deliverables: 1) a one-page matrix PDF for Sales, 2) an intake template pre-filled by CS for initial scoring, 3) a short engineering checklist for feasibility gate.
scoring_rubric: Stakeholder weighting: assign weights to Requestor, Legal/Compliance, Security, Engineering, and Customer Success (0-5). Multiply request priority by stakeholder weight to get component scores.
Business value: expected ARR uplift or risk mitigation (0-none, 1-small, 2-medium, 3-high). Capture as numeric estimate or band.

Deployment fit heuristics: checklist of guarantees (SLA latency target, PII residency, encryption/KMS, on-prem requirement). Each affirmative increases probability of Dedicated/Private recommendation.
Effort banding: map to S (1-2 wks), M (2-6 wks), L (6-12 wks), XL (12+ wks) and indicate likely engineering points range (1/3/8/13) and infra delta (none/moderate/high/very high).
Decision thresholds: auto-flag for escalation when combined stakeholder-weighted score >= 18 OR customer_impact == high OR deployment constraints require Private deployment.
Economics proxy: embed a quick ARR-to-effort multiplier (e.g., if expected ARR > $250k and effort <= L, recommend pursuing dedicated scoping with Sales leader).
Confidence band: the person doing the intake must mark confidence (low/medium/high) and list missing clarifying questions for Solutions Eng.
acceptance_criteria: A one-page matrix PDF and intake checklist exists and is accessible to Sales/CS in the shared drive.
Template auto-calculates recommended deployment (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) and flags escalation when thresholds hit.
Three pilot intake sessions completed with Solutions Eng and two AE teams; feedback incorporated.
Initial scoping bands validated by Eng lead and Solutions Eng with at most one follow-up clarification in pilot cases.
Dashboard metric defined to track the time from intake submission to go/no-go decision.
Documentation includes explicit fields for regulatory constraints, KMS/HSM requirement, and data residency needs.
Training slide deck and 30-minute office hours session scheduled for Sales/CS.
notes_and_risks: Risk: Over-weighting Sales urgency could surface low-economics asks. Mitigation: require economic band and AE manager sign-off for requests with stakeholder-weighted score >= 20.
Risk: Engineering estimates might drift after discovery. Mitigation: label all outputs as "first-pass" with a confidence band and require a formal eng spike for L/XL scopes.
Observation: Some customers ask for features that are product roadmap items — matrix should gate product roadmap fit vs account-specific custom work.
Operational note: We'll need a lightweight automator (Zapier or internal form + Google Sheet) to compute the matrix before we invest in UI work.
Legal/regulatory dependencies may force Private deployments; include explicit checkbox to escalate to Legal early.
This ticket depends on ENG-2749 for the engineering checklist template and PM-31416 for intake template alignment.
Measure success: reduce Sales <-> Eng clarification cycles by 40% and reduce average intake-to-decision time from ~10 days to <= 3 business days in pilot.
